messages:
Aisha PM: Quick sync — we need to lock the eligibility & onboarding windows for the Private Beta cohort. Proposed: 6-week onboarding period (setup, training, integration) + 8-week active feedback window. Also suggesting a 2-week opt-in period after invite. Thoughts?

Jules Eng: +1 on the split. Concern: 6 weeks for onboarding might be heavy for small startups. Can we make onboarding modular? :thinking:

Sam Design: We should separate 'integration' vs 'feature feedback'. Integration can be short (2 weeks) if we provide a config kit + runbook. Feature feedback needs the longer window.

Maya Solutions: For enterprise customers, legal + security review usually takes 3-4 weeks. Need to account for that before onboarding starts. Recommend we define 'contract signed' -> 'kickoff window' buffer.

Elliot Research: For quality monitoring we need at least 6 weeks of real traffic to surface meaningful regressions. 8-week active feedback sounds good to me.

Beth Legal: Agreed on buffer. Also need to include an NDA/DP agreement step in the invite flow. Can we add a step: Invite -> Sign NDA -> Security questionnaire -> Kickoff? That will impact timeline.

Aisha PM: Good calls. Proposal update: Invite (2w opt-in) -> Sign NDA & Sec QA (target 2-4w) -> Onboarding (2-4w depending on size) -> Active Feedback (8w). That gives overall 14w worst-case. Is that acceptable?

Jules Eng: Yes if we define a 'fast-path' for small teams: opt-in + checklist -> 2w onboarding, 8w feedback. We need to document criteria for fast-path.

Sam Design: I'll draft the fast-path checklist. Quick ask: can marketing own the invite copy? I have variant A/B phrasing for the opt-in email.

Maya Solutions: Please include required artifacts in checklist (API tokens, VPC contact, SSO team). Those are common blockers.

Aisha PM: Draft invite copy would be super helpful. Sam — if you post the two variants I can run them past legal.

Sam Design: Posted both variants:

```
Variant A subject: Join Redwood Private Beta — 6-week integration + 8-week feedback
Body: Hi <name>, we'd like you to try Redwood Private for low-latency inference. Expect a quick setup call, sample prompts, and 8 weeks of guided feedback. Reply to confirm interest.
```

```
Variant B subject: Exclusive Private Beta access — flexible onboarding
Body: Hi <name>, we're inviting a small set of partners to test Redwood Private. We'll tailor onboarding to your team's needs. Commit to 8 weeks of feedback to help shape the product.
```

Beth Legal: Minor wording ask — remove commitment language that implies SLA. Suggest 'expected feedback cadence' instead of 'commit to'.

Aisha PM: Noted. I'll update the workflow doc with: invite variants, fast-path criteria, onboarding checklist, security gating, and success metrics (engagement, issue rate, regression delta). Target to publish internal playbook by next Tue.

ci-bot: New doc created: /playbooks/private-beta/onboarding-runbook (aisha)

Jules Eng: Thanks — can we add a rollout gate: 10 active partners with >80% onboarding completion before GA?

Elliot Research: Also add quality gate: no high-severity regression vs baseline in last 4 weeks before GA.

Aisha PM: Adding both gates. Final question: Do we keep cohort size open or cap at 25 for the first wave? :question:

Maya Solutions: Cap at 20 for the first wave — gives room for targeted support.

Sam Design: Cap 20 sounds right. :thumbsup:

Aisha PM: OK — plan: cap 20, fast-path criteria recorded, invite variants updated, playbook by Tue. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
